articles.title: NOT JUST A LABEL — Homepage Feature

sections.body: Our design house has been honoured with a homepage feature by NOT JUST A LABEL (NJAL), one of the world's most significant authorities on independent fashion. Selected among designers NJAL identifies as representing the future of independent fashion.

articles.title: PAUL COSTELLOE AW26 — London Fashion Week
articles.summary: We were proud to be one of the official jewellery partners for the Paul Costelloe Autumn/Winter 2026 collection, the debut show under William Costelloe’s creative direction at London Fashion Week.

sections.body:
We were proud to be one of the official jewellery partners for the **Paul Costelloe Autumn/Winter 2026 collection**, the debut show under William Costelloe’s creative direction at **London Fashion Week**.

Hosted in the enchanting atmosphere of **The Waldorf Hilton**, our pieces were integrated into the runway through the meticulous curation of the creative team and stylist Borna Prikaski. This partnership served as a powerful expression of our traditional craft heritage and experimental architectural lines on the high-fashion stage.

articles.title: BOREHAMWOOD TIMES: From Local Roots to Runway
articles.summary: Our journey, stretching from local roots to global runways, was featured in the editorial pages of the Borehamwood Times.

sections.body:
Our journey, stretching from local roots to global runways, was featured in the editorial pages of the **Borehamwood Times**.

The article documents our design methodology—spanning from traditional silversmithing disciplines to the mathematical precision of software code—and our brand’s debut on the London Fashion Week opening show stage within its first year.

articles.title: FLANELLE MAGAZINE: The Interaction of Shadow and Metal

sections.body:
Our hand-crafted silver and bronze structures were featured in an editorial for the prestigious avant-garde fashion publication, **Flanelle Magazine**.

articles.title: KALTBLUT MAGAZINE — "THE DISH"
articles.summary: Silver & Elegant designs were curated for "THE DISH," a digital editorial in KALTBLUT Magazine exploring contemporary jewellery engineering and avant-garde creative direction.

sections.body:
Silver & Elegant designs were curated for **"THE DISH,"** a digital editorial exploring the boundaries of contemporary jewellery engineering and avant-garde creative direction.

Published in **KALTBLUT Magazine**, this exclusive selection emphasises the sculptural posture and structural strength of jewellery on the body.

_Silver & Elegant founder Esen Tunalı Sarı on craft, slowness, and the decision to build a brand before the market asks you to._

Speaking at Rise Her Collective's Istanbul gathering — a community platform for women entrepreneurs — the question came midway through the talk: how do you stay committed to slowness when everything around you is moving faster?

Silver & Elegant was three months old at the time. No track record, no archive, no proof of concept beyond the work itself and the philosophy behind it. Which made the question harder — and more honest — than it might have been later.

The answer is structural. Slowness is not a discipline maintained against pressure. It is a decision made at the level of the object, before anything else. A piece designed to be passed down cannot also be designed quickly. Once that is understood, everything else — the commission model, the refusal of volume, the absence of seasonal collections — follows logically. The business does not shape the work. The work shapes the business.

Three months in, that conviction is the only thing that exists. There is no scale yet, no history, no accumulated evidence that the position is correct. There is only the clarity of the original decision and the objects it produces.

sections.body:
SILVER & ELEGANT is pleased to announce that its Founder and Creative Director, Esen Tunalı Sarı, has been elected as a Fellow of the Royal Society of Arts (FRSA).

This fellowship recognises the ongoing research and design practice behind the brand - specifically the commitment to bridging the gap between algorithmic design and the structural discipline of traditional metalwork. The RSA has long supported those who seek to advance the intersection of arts, manufacturing, and commerce; this appointment reflects the brand's dedication to exploring the boundaries of permanent, architectural jewellery.

_"Jewellery is not an object. It is a permanent story."_

_— Esen Tunalı Sarı, FRSA_

articles.title: Recognition: Royal Society of Arts Fellowship
articles.summary: Architectural narratives at the intersection of algorithmic logic and artisanal craftsmanship. An exploration of **SILVER & ELEGANT**'s design discipline and its evolving vision, marked by the recent Royal Society of Arts (RSA) Fellowship.

sections.body:
Wolf & Badger — the London-based independent fashion and design platform with its flagship store on Berwick Street, Soho — featured Silver & Elegant in its March 2026 Jewellery Guide, distributed to its global customer base.

  

For an independent brand in its first year, inclusion in a curated guide of this kind represents something specific: external recognition that the work has found its audience beyond the immediate network of its making.

  

Silver & Elegant continues to engineer narrative objects of permanence. The work speaks for itself. Occasionally, others speak for it too.
